description: Student asks whether a 3D structure can be axisymmetric; no agent has answered. Director must NOT emit END.

input.conversationSummary:
[Agent] Today we study axial symmetry. The Tiananmen gate tower is a classic example — its facade looks identical on the left and right.
[Agent] Yes, very symmetric! I can see how both sides mirror each other.
[Student (Human)] Wait — the gate tower is a 3D structure, not a flat shape. Can a 3D object really be called axisymmetric? I thought symmetry only applies to 2D shapes.
